headline: Earnings beat on better volumes; demand resilient

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Petronet LNG Earnings beat on better volumes; demand resilient Oil & Gas  Result Update  November 04, 2026 CMP (Rs): 303 | TP (Rs): 370 PLNG reported 2QFY27 SA EBITDA/APAT of Rs18.0/13.4bn, up 10%/11% qoq and 5%/6% above our estimates, driven by better-than-expected volumes and lower opex, while implied spot margins at $7.6/mmbtu missed estimates by 9%.
Dahej utilization improved to 75% from 67% qoq, supported by higher supplies from QatarEnergy (QE) and 7% rise in tolling volumes.
Kochi utilization was lower at ~23%, but volumes are expected to improve following completion of the Kochi-Bengaluru pipeline, targeted for FY27-end.
We raise FY27E earnings by 20%, factoring in the higher unit margins and volumes; we raise FY28/29E earnings by 2% each.
valuation: Kochi utilization was lower at ~23%, but volumes are expected to improve following completion of the Kochi-Bengaluru pipeline, targeted for FY27-end.
